source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "fr_FR.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "Europe/Paris"))
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(gt)

meteo_station <- function(station_id = "07156",
                          from = Sys.Date() - days(1),
                          to   = Sys.Date(),
                          interactive_limit = 20) {

  data <- tibble(date = seq.Date(from = from, to = to, by = "day")) %>%
    
    mutate(
      url = paste0(
        "https://www.meteo60.fr/stations-releves/station-jour-csv?station_id=-",
        station_id,
        "&date=",
        format(date, "%d/%m/%Y")
      )
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(data = purrr::map(url, readr::read_delim, show_col_types = FALSE)) %>%
    
    mutate(data = purrr::map(data, \(df) {
      df$Vent_moyen <- as.character(df$Vent_moyen)
      df
    })) %>%
    
    unnest(data) %>%
    select(-url, -...15) %>%
    arrange(desc(date), desc(Heure_UTC)) %>%
    
    relocate(date, .after = last_col()) %>%
    relocate(Heure_UTC, .after = last_col()) %>%
    
    select(
      Heure_legale,
      Temperature,
      Temps,
      Vent_moyen,
      Humidite_relative,
      everything()
    ) %>%
    
    mutate(
      # icônes météo
      icon = case_when(
        str_detect(Temps, regex("soleil|clair", TRUE)) ~ "☀️",
        str_detect(Temps, regex("nuage", TRUE)) ~ "⛅",
        str_detect(Temps, regex("pluie|averse", TRUE)) ~ "🌧️",
        str_detect(Temps, regex("orage", TRUE)) ~ "⛈️",
        str_detect(Temps, regex("brouillard|brume", TRUE)) ~ "🌫️",
        str_detect(Temps, regex("neige", TRUE)) ~ "❄️",
        TRUE ~ ""
      ),
      Temps = paste(icon, Temps)
    )

  interactive_mode <- nrow(data) > interactive_limit

  gt_tbl <- data %>%
    gt() %>%
    
    # largeur adaptative
    cols_width(
      Temps ~ px(150)
    ) %>%
    
    cols_align(
      "center",
      c(Temperature, Vent_moyen, Humidite_relative)
    ) %>%
    
    # coloration température
    data_color(
      columns = Temperature,
      colors = scales::col_numeric(
        palette = c("#2c7bb6", "#abd9e9", "#66bd63", "#fdae61", "#d7191c"),
        domain = NULL
      )
    ) %>%
    
    tab_options(
      table.width = pct(100),
      data_row.padding = px(4)
    ) %>%
    
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = md(
        paste0(
          "Date : ",
          format(Sys.time(), "%A %d %B %Y, %Hh%M"),
          ". Source : https://www.infoclimat.fr/observations-meteo/temps-reel/",
          station_id,
          ".html"
        )
      )
    )

  if (interactive_mode) {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      opt_interactive(
        use_search = FALSE,
        use_pagination = TRUE,
        use_compact_mode = TRUE,
        page_size_default = interactive_limit
      )
  }

  gt_tbl
}

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(readr)
library(gt)

meteo_station_last_days <- function(station_id = "07156",
                                    n_days = 30,
                                    as_gt = TRUE,
                                    interactive_limit = 20) {

  stopifnot(n_days > 0)

  today <- Sys.Date()
  start_date <- today - n_days + 1

  months_needed <- seq(floor_date(start_date, "month"),
                       floor_date(today, "month"),
                       by = "1 month")

  data <- purrr::map_dfr(months_needed, \(d) {

    url <- paste0(
      "https://www.meteo60.fr/stations-releves/station-mois-csv?station_id=",
      station_id,
      "&mois=", month(d),
      "&annee=", year(d) - 2000
    )

    read_delim(url, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      as_tibble() %>%
      select(-7) %>%
      mutate(
        jour = parse_number(Jour),
        date = as.Date(ISOdate(year(d), month(d), jour))
      )
  }) %>%
    filter(date >= start_date & date <= today) %>%
    arrange(desc(date)) %>%
    select(date, Jour, everything(), -jour)

  if (!as_gt) return(data)

  interactive_mode <- nrow(data) > interactive_limit

  gt_tbl <- data %>%
    gt() %>%
    
    # largeur adaptative (aucune contrainte sauf si nécessaire)
    tab_options(
      table.width = gt::pct(100),
      data_row.padding = gt::px(4)
    ) %>%
    
    # 🌡️ coloration température si colonne présente
    {
      if ("Temperature" %in% names(data)) {
        data_color(.,
          columns = Temperature,
          colors = scales::col_numeric(
            palette = c("#2c7bb6", "#abd9e9", "#66bd63", "#fdae61", "#d7191c"),
            domain = NULL
          )
        )
      } else .
    } %>%
    
    tab_footnote(
      footnote = gt::md(
        paste0(
          n_days, " derniers jours. Généré le ",
          format(Sys.time(), "%A %d %B %Y, %Hh%M"),
          ". Source : https://www.meteo60.fr/"
        )
      )
    )

  if (interactive_mode) {
    gt_tbl <- gt_tbl |>
      opt_interactive(
        use_search = FALSE,
        use_pagination = TRUE,
        use_pagination_info = FALSE,
        use_compact_mode = TRUE,
        page_size_default = interactive_limit,
        page_size_values = c(10, 20, 50, 100)
      )
  }

  gt_tbl
}
